outcomeNote: Halakhic ruling: lenient in both disputes (imprecise enunciation valid; inaudible recitation valid).

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי טָבִי אָמַר רַבִּי יֹאשִׁיָּה: הֲלָכָה כְּדִבְרֵי שְׁנֵיהֶם לְהָקֵל.
segments.en: «Rabbi Tavi said» that «Rabbi Yoshiya said: The halakha is in accordance with» «the statements in both» disputes that rule «leniently».

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי טבי אמר רבי יאשיה: הלכה כדברי שניהם להקל
moves.summary: R' Tavi in R' Yoshiya's name rules leniently in both disputes of the mishna
moves.about: the ruling that the halakha follows the lenient view in both disputes

edges.cueHe: אמר רבי טבי אמר רבי יאשיה
edges.about: the ruling that the halakha follows the lenient view in both disputes
in the imprecise-enunciation dispute the halakha follows the lenient view (R' Yosei: he fulfilled)
in the inaudible-recitation dispute the halakha follows the lenient view (he fulfilled), ascribed to R' Yehuda in the mishna as cited at 15a.13
